output.original_text: Ahayye💃💃💃dolene baban director dole kace wnan episode yafi burge ka sbd anyi show sosai. Allah yasaka mah rukayya dan tafadi gaskia dan Mahmud bashida liver na saka mace ta so shi, itakuma sumayya ta zirma da yawa sosai. Allah dai yabiya ka director💃💃
output.joy: Ahayye! 💃💃💃 Baban director, wannan episode ya burge ni sosai saboda mun yi show mai kyau! Allah ya saka mah rukayya da gaske ga Mahmud, domin yana da kyau sosai, sannan Sumayya ma ta yi kyau kwarai! Allah ya kara muku nasara, director! 💃💃
output.sadness: Ahayye💃💃💃 Baban director, ina jin cewa wannan episode ba ta yi mana dadin ba sosai, sabili da yadda muka so mu yi show. Allah ya taimaka tare da rukayya, amma gaskiya Mahmud ba ya nuna kulawa, Sumayya ma ba ta yi fice ba. Allah ya bamu karin hakuri, director💃💃
output.fear: Ahayye💃💃💃 Baban director, ina jin tsoro a game da wannan episode, sabili da yadda zai shafi show din mu. Allah ya kiyaye rukayya, saboda Mahmud ba ya da yawan masu son sa, kuma Sumayya na iya zama ba ta yi kyau ba. Allah ya kiyaye, director💃💃
output.anger: Ahayye💃💃💃 Baban director, ya kamata ka sani cewa wannan episode yana da matukar ban sha'awa! Allah ya sa a yi wa rukayya adalci saboda Mahmud ba ya cancanci hakan! Yanzu Sumayya ta kuma zirma da yawa! Ku gyara, director! 💃💃
